title: Business Controller - Global Financial Crime & Fraud Prevention
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€6.500,60 - €10.389,47
We’re hiring: Business Controller – Global Financial Crime & Fraud Prevention (Amsterdam HQ)
This is a head office role at ING, part of the Global COO organisation. You’ll cover the entire bank’s operational finance business control activities for the Global Financial Crime & Fraud Prevention domain, directly linked to both the Global COO and the Group Finance of ING. You’ll be part of a tight team of 7 experienced finance professionals who advise at the very centre of the bank’s decision-making.
This is not accounting. Not project control. This is true Business Control / FP&A at the global level — where your analysis and advice directly influence strategy and performance for the whole bank.
Roles and responsibilities
Act as a trusted advisor to the Management Team of the Global Financial Crime & Fraud Prevention, Group COO and CFO, and Group Finance.
Lead budgeting & forecasting, aligning and challenging senior stakeholders across all locations and Head Office.
Functionally manageand coach 1-2 team members supporting the domain business control processes
Translate complex financials into sharp, actionable insights.
Drive discussions on cost modelling, allocation, and efficiency.
Support strategic initiatives and transformation projects with financial expertise.
At least 5 years of proven experience in Business Control and/or FP&A. (If your background is only in accounting or project control, this role is not a fit.)
Strong communication and influencing skills — confident with senior stakeholders.
Able to navigate a large, complex, and often ambiguous global matrix organisation - proactive, resilient, and not thrown off by competing priorities.
Analytical, hands-on, and comfortable with challenging the status quo.
Advanced Excel & PowerPoint; Power BI, Hyperion, SmartView are a plus.
A senior, high-impact role with visibility to the Global Financial Crime & Fraud Prevention senior leadership, Group COO and Group Finance
A place in a high-performing team of 7 finance professionals driving performance at group level.
Career opportunities within ING’s global finance community of hundreds of professionals in the Netherlands and abroad.
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditionshere.
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
A salary indication tailored to your qualities and experience in GJA18
36 or 40-hour workweek
12-month contract with view to extend
Individual leave: 24+2 individual holiday days based on 36 hr workweek
Diversity leave: 3 days per year (1,5 paid, 1,5 unpaid)
CSR days: up to 2 days per year to actively engage in society by volunteering
Individual Savings Contribution (BIS), 3.5% of your gross annual salary
Attractive pension scheme
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Want to apply directly?
Upload yourCV and motivation letterby clicking the “Apply” button.
Please note, multiple interview steps involving various business stakeholders will be part of the selection process.
With 60,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what’s possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer’s interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us and apply today!
